name: The Climats, terroirs of Burgundy
description: Along the slopes south of Dijon, the Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune are stitched together from hundreds of tiny, precisely bounded vineyard plots called climats. Each has its own soil, sun exposure and grape, and so its own distinct wine. Monks and dukes have tended and mapped them since the Middle Ages, and you can wander between the vines, wine villages, the town of Beaune and Dijon's old centre.
